Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

cloudscape 0.3.0

Usability of partly observed cells

  • cl_clear_obs(), cl_gaps(), cl_persistence() and cl_seasonality() gain coverage = TRUE: a cell-observation is usable when at least 1 - threshold of the whole cell was observed and cloud-free, so that a cell seen over part of its area cannot pass on the cloud fraction of that part alone. cl_clear_prob() multiplies by the valid share of the cell.
  • Seasons (by = "season") are meteorological (DJF, MAM, JJA, SON), with December counted in the following year’s winter.

Phenological retrieval error

  • cl_pheno_power() retains each simulated acquisition with the probability that a pixel at a random location in the cell is observed and clear, and draws cloud loss from a latent Gaussian process whose correlation decays as exp(-lag / tau) over the actual intervals between acquisitions (argument tau, in days; persistence is deprecated). It reports the probability that each date is retrieved within tolerance days, the median and expected number of retained acquisitions and the reference dates of the curve, and offers whole-cell retention (retention = "cell") as an alternative.
  • cl_pheno_power() orders acquisition dates and their cloud and valid fractions together before simulating; unsorted input previously paired dates with the wrong fractions.

Observation tables and quality layers

  • cl_obs() takes further named columns through ... and keeps them aligned with the observations when it sorts them, and takes percent to state the scale of the fractions. cl_qa_obs() and cl_items_to_obs() use this, so that identifiers, times and valid shares stay with their observations when several sensors are read together.
  • cl_qa_decode() treats categorical classes that are neither cloud, cloud shadow, snow nor listed as clear as invalid: Sentinel-2 SCL class 1 (saturated or defective) is invalid, and class 2 (topographic cast shadow) is valid, cloud-free and coded terrain_shadow. Missing values are invalid for all sensors. Flags absent from a specification are never raised, so Landsat 4-7 decodes with the default include_cirrus = TRUE. Bit fields of several bits are supported and used for the MODIS cloud state and cirrus fields. confidence = "low" is no longer accepted, because the Landsat Collection 2 algorithm assigns low cloud confidence to almost all clear pixels.
  • The MODIS driver no longer queries the Planetary Computer, which serves 8-day composites rather than daily acquisitions.
  • cl_search(backend = "planetary") matches the catalogue’s platform names, reads Sentinel-2 tile identifiers from s2:mgrs_tile, and keeps the latest processing version of each tile; asset names are matched without regard to case.

Availability statistics

  • cl_gaps() closes the record at period boundaries with virtual observations on the day before and the day after the period, so that edge gaps are measured like interior ones, and reports the number of distinct usable dates as n_clear_dates (formerly n_clear_obs, which in cl_clear_obs() counts usable acquisitions).
  • cl_seasonality() reports fits in which usable and unusable acquisitions are separated by day of year, flagged separated = TRUE, instead of returning NA for the most seasonal cells.
  • cl_clear_prob(model = "clustered") returns the probability that an observation is usable at the new argument threshold; its documentation no longer describes the independent model as an upper bound.
  • cl_stats_merge() returns NA, with a warning, for gap statistics, counts of distinct dates and phenological errors, which cannot be combined from summaries, and for combinations with missing values or sample sizes.
  • cl_synergy() computes the effective revisit from the days of each period inside the requested window. cl_feasibility() closes gaps at the window boundaries as cl_gaps() does.
  • Usability thresholds outside [0, 1] are rejected, and acquisitions without a cloud fraction are left out of persistence and seasonality fits.

Evaluation and grids

  • cl_roc() computes the area under the curve exactly from ranks; cl_validate() computes the Matthews correlation without integer overflow; cl_confusion() compares logical masks with 0/1 references; cl_compare() resamples pixels or blocks with replacement and keeps every copy, and leaves out missing pixels.
  • cl_agreement() and cl_disagreement() threshold a mask set without a class layer at its own threshold; strata without a label are left out.
  • cl_grid() accepts only EPSG:6933, the projection its cell coordinates are computed in, and stops when the grid would exceed the range of integer cell identifiers; cl_grid_cells() reports the area inside the projection’s domain for cells past the poles or the antimeridian.
  • cl_scale() keeps the reflectance of a cl_scene in its raster or list form.
  • The scene explorer (cl_explore()) no longer shows cloud-method and threshold controls that had no effect.

cloudscape 0.2.0

  • New cl_qa_obs() builds the quality-layer evidence tier: for every cell-observation it reads the producer quality layer (Landsat QA_PIXEL, Sentinel-2 SCL) over the cell and records the shares of valid pixels flagged as cloud, cloud shadow and snow, with the share of the cell holding valid data. Landsat assets listed in the requester-pays USGS bucket are read from the Planetary Computer mirror with an anonymous access token; when the mirror holds another processing version of a scene, the path is taken from the mirror’s own catalogue record.
  • cl_persistence() reports two further decorrelation times. tau_days fits every pair of acquisitions at its actual lag instead of converting a lag-1 correlation with the median interval, and tau_deseasonalised_days measures persistence relative to a seasonal cloud probability, so that the seasonal cycle is not counted as persistence. Its documentation no longer describes the estimate as a lower bound, which holds only for misclassification that is independent between acquisitions.
  • cl_pheno_power() reports the error in the timing of the seasonal peak and the median biases of start and end of season.
  • cl_search() keeps each acquisition once, in its latest processing version (latest = TRUE); Earth Search lists many Sentinel-2 acquisitions of 2019-2021 twice. It requests pages of 100 items, halves the page size when the catalogue answers with a gateway error, and warns when limit stops it before the last page.
  • The documentation of cl_grid_index() states when centroid containment agrees with exact area overlap, and the package description and vignettes describe the pixel-level detectors as experimental.
  • The startup message points to ?cloudscape, which exists, instead of a help topic that does not.
  • analysis/ holds the scripts and archived inputs of the worked example (Andong, Republic of Korea, 2019-2024).

cloudscape 0.1.1

  • cl_pheno_fit(model = "dbl_logistic") now derives its starting values from the data. The fixed starting values used before, which placed green-up on day 110 and senescence on day 290, caused avoidable convergence failures for seasons that fall earlier or later in the year. The former values are kept as the last of the starting points tried.
  • A start list supplied to cl_pheno_fit() is now matched to the parameters by name. The parameter bounds were previously applied by position, so a list in any other order failed to fit. An incomplete list is now an error.
  • cl_pheno_power() reports insufficient_rate, the share of replicates with too few usable observations to fit. Its documentation now states that failure_rate includes these replicates.
  • Messages from the learned cloud detectors and from cl_benchmark() no longer refer to a companion data package, which has not been released.
  • R CMD check passes: a test that reads the package sources is now skipped outside the development tree, an expected warning is asserted rather than leaked, and assertions that relied on relative tolerances now state absolute ones. The pkgdown reference index lists every help topic.

cloudscape 0.1.0

First development release.

  • Equal-area analysis grid (EASE-Grid 2.0, EPSG:6933) with a closed-form ellipsoidal projection that requires no PROJ installation.
  • Sensor driver registry: Landsat 4-9, Sentinel-2, MODIS, generic/UAV.
  • Pluggable cloud-probability methods: threshold, fmask, qa, plus registered stubs for learned methods.
  • Geometric cloud-shadow projection with cloud-height search, thermal height estimation, and explicit separation of terrain shadow from cloud shadow.
  • Synthetic cloud and shadow simulation sharing the detector’s geometry kernel.
  • Availability statistics: clear observations, gap distributions, seasonality, multi-constellation synergy, sampling feasibility.
  • Phenological retrieval-error simulation.
  • Evaluation with bootstrap intervals, McNemar tests and calibration metrics.
  • cl_stats enforces units, sample sizes and denominators on construction.
